title: Client Connector install parameters and deployment

prose.text: Install parameters are values handed to Client Connector when it is deployed, before it has downloaded any policy. {{delivery}}

steps.label: Who is the user, and which tenant?
steps.text: Domain, cloud, device token, username and the MDM correlation ID: [[zcc.install.enrollment]].

steps.label: Must the device be blocked until it enrolls?
steps.text: Strict enforcement, the policy token it depends on, and the fail-close file: [[zcc.install.strict-enforcement]]. Enrolling new users during an outage: [[zcc.install.business-continuity]].

steps.label: Does an install parameter or a console setting win?
Windows-only switches.
steps.text: The filter driver: [[zcc.install.windows-driver]]. Browser, SSO and Imprivata sign-in: [[zcc.install.authentication-options]]. Silent install, upgrade, revert and uninstall, and launch behavior: [[zcc.install.windows-unattended]].

steps.label: macOS through an MDM.
steps.text: The package, the preference domain and the plist: [[zcc.install.macos-deployment]]. System extensions, VPN payloads and privacy profiles: [[zcc.install.macos-extensions]].

steps.label: Client Connector inside Azure desktops.
steps.text: Windows 365 Cloud PCs and Azure Virtual Desktop host pools: [[zcc.install.azure-virtual-desktop]].

prose.text: Runtime behavior that is configured in the console rather than at install time lives in the forwarding profile ([[zcc.forwarding-profiles]]) and the app profile ([[zcc.app-profiles]]).

delivery.statement: Each platform takes install parameters through its own channel: on Windows they are passed when installing manually or through GPO, SCCM or another device-management method, with different names for the MSI and the EXE installer; on macOS they are PLIST settings deployed from an MDM alongside a pkg installation; on iOS they come from an MDM; on Android and Android on ChromeOS from an MDM with Android Enterprise enabled.

quotes: You can preconfigure these parameters when manually installing Zscaler Client Connector on a Windows device or deploying Zscaler Client Connector using GPO, SCCM, or other device management methods.
The parameter names are different based on whether you are using an MSI file or an EXE file.

You can preconfigure these parameters when deploying Zscaler Client Connector using a pkg installation process with property list (PLIST) configuration settings deployed from a mobile device management (MDM) solution.
You can preconfigure these parameters when deploying Zscaler Client Connector from a mobile device management (MDM) system.
You can preconfigure these parameters when deploying Zscaler Client Connector from a mobile device management (MDM) system with Android Enterprise enabled.
